news.headline: Delcath Systems Given Consensus Rating of "Moderate Buy" by Brokerages
news.summary: A roundup of sell-side coverage shows Delcath holding a consensus "Moderate Buy" rating with an average 12-month price target around $21-24, reflecting broad but not unanimous analyst bullishness after the Q2 beat.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Updates Bylaws to Designate Delaware Courts as Exclusive Forum
news.summary: Delcath's board amended and restated the company's bylaws, effective immediately, to make the Delaware Court of Chancery (or federal district court for Delaware) the exclusive forum for internal corporate claims and U.S. federal courts the exclusive forum for Securities Act claims.

news.headline: Zacks Research Upgrades Delcath Systems to Strong-Buy; Shares Hit New 52-Week High
news.summary: Zacks moved Delcath from Hold to Strong-Buy and the stock touched a fresh 52-week high of about $17.42 intraday, extending the post-earnings rally.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright Raises Delcath Price Target to $32, Reiterates Buy
news.summary: H.C. Wainwright lifted its price target on Delcath to $32 from $30 following the Q2 beat and raised guidance, maintaining a Buy rating; BTIG similarly raised its target to $21 from $17 the same week.

news.headline: Delcath Systems Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results, Raises Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Q2 2026 total revenue rose to $29.1 million (+20% YoY) with HEPZATO KIT revenue of $27.1 million, 90% gross margin, and net income of $2.7 million; the company raised FY2026 guidance to $104-108 million with positive adjusted EBITDA and $95.9 million in cash with no debt.

news.headline: Independent Data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 Shows 60% Hepatic Response Rate with HEPZATO/PHP
news.summary: Investigator-presented retrospective data in heavily pretreated, liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer patients showed a 60% hepatic partial response rate using percutaneous hepatic perfusion, supporting the ongoing Phase 2 breast cancer trial now dosing patients in Milan.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings
catalysts.detail: Next quarterly results and updated guidance/treatment-center count; exact date not yet announced.

catalysts.label: Additional HEPZATO treatment center activations
catalysts.detail: Company targets roughly 6 more center activations to reach ~37 active centers by year-end 2026 (40 centers now guided for Q1 2027).

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC hepatic-PFS readout
catalysts.detail: Primary endpoint (hepatic progression-free survival) for the ~90-patient global Phase 2 liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer trial; overall survival data expected late 2028 (timeline pushed out from prior 'late 2027' estimate).

catalysts.label: Phase 2 metastatic breast cancer trial enrollment/data
catalysts.detail: Global Phase 2 trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care in liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer is actively screening across 6 sites with first patient dosed in Milan (July 2026); interim signals could follow further ESMO/ASCO-style disclosures.

pulse: Delcath's commercial momentum from the Q2 2026 beat (revenue +20% YoY, raised FY26 guidance to $104-108M, $95.9M cash, no debt) continued to drive the stock to fresh 52-week highs (~$17.40) and further analyst price-target increases (H.C. Wainwright to $32, BTIG to $21) through mid-August. Since then, news flow has thinned to housekeeping (a Delaware exclusive-forum bylaws amendment) and a consensus-rating roundup confirming a 'Moderate Buy' stance, with no major new catalysts disclosed between August 13-27. The near-term story remains steady HEPZATO volume/center-activation growth, with the next hard catalyst being Q3 2026 earnings likely in November and pipeline readouts (breast cancer, colorectal cancer) pushed out to 2028.
